decisions.finding: The vav has a detached broad horizontal mark, 28 pixels wide and ten high, with no long lower stem. The same-row Daniel10a dalet qamats has a substantial central descending stem; that geometry is absent here. Preserve the already transcribed yod dagesh and all other points.

Root and a second independent assistant replayed raw native pixels: after the head narrows to the right tail at y1358..1359, an additional round low-left lobe appears x1345..1354 at y1360..1369, with clean white separation beside the continuing right tail at y1368..1369. Three ordinary local yods have single curved tails without this branch; the first Daniel on the same row has a detached dagesh in the analogous position. This diagnostic extra lobe certifies a fused printed dagesh, without supplying a point from grammar or the repeated name. The preparing assistant recommended retention; its original finding is retained separately.
